articles.title: 12 international students at Calgary protest referred to CBSA office after status check
articles.summary: A dozen people who took part in a weeks-long international student protest in northeast Calgary have been flagged as "being possibly inadmissible" and, according to an immigration lawyer, could be forced to leave Canada.
